full_judgment: 17. On the face of the facts and circumstances of the case the title of the petitioner is clouded and not free from dispute and thus the appropriate forum for the petitioner is to seek title in the civil court which has the power to take evidence to resolve disputed question of fact. Once the petitioner will be able to establish his title by way of obtaining a decree from a competent civil court, he will be entitled to get the property mutated in his name. Since there is alternative remedy available under the law the present writ petitions are not maintainable. The issue raised in the instant writ petition is a highly disputed question of fact which cannot be decided under writ jurisdiction of this Division.
